title: Microsoft Intune: new enrollment policies experience for iOS/iPadOS automated device enrollment
summary: Pass: the enrollment time grouping path and beta API are documented, and the briefing reports the differences between Microsoft's sources rather than hiding them. Minor corrections concern an omitted wizard page and checklist controls missing from the controls table.
